title: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale
description: 10 items about the past seven days, each with its own four options scored 0–3.

citation.text: Cox JL, Holden JM, Sagovsky R (1987). Detection of postnatal depression: development of the 10-item Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale. British Journal of Psychiatry 150:782–786.

scoring.text: Sum of the 10 items (0–30); cut-offs of 10 and 13 are common. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.

note: Enter each item's four options in score order (0 first); on the printed form items 3 and 5–10 run the other way. Item 10 (self-harm) is a safety item.
